fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'.

fields.label: Pubsub Topic
fields.help: The pubsub topic that you want the metadata feed messages to publish to.

fields.label: Filters
Aspect Types
fields.help: The aspect types that you want to listen to.

fields.label: Change Types
fields.help: The type of change that you want to listen to.

fields.label: Entry Types
fields.help: The entry types that you want to listen to, specified as relative resource names in the format projects/{project_id_or_number}/locations/{location}/entryTypes/{entry_type_id}.
Filters defines the type of changes that you want to listen to.

fields.label: Scope
Entry Groups
fields.help: The entry groups whose entries you want to listen to.

fields.label: Organization Level
fields.help: Whether the metadata feed is at the organization-level.

fields.label: Projects
fields.help: The projects whose entries you want to listen to.
Scope defines the scope of the metadata feed.
